records.limitation: Evidence is limited to processed pork matrices and does not establish higher creatine intake or cerebral target engagement.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Heating protocols altered creatine-to-creatinine conversion in pork/ham materials.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Composition retention only, not brain effects; no advice to undercook food.

records.exposure_qualification: Composition-preservation practice in tested pork products only; preserve food safety, no brain-efficacy or undercooking advice.

records.pm_mission: Regulate the expression of cellular defence genes in response to oxidative and electrophilic stress.
records.biological_role: Three daily doses of broccoli sprouts, blended with water and daikon sprouts and held at 37°C so myrosinase could finish forming sulforaphane, increased phase II enzyme RNA in nasal cells of healthy adults. The authors read that shared pattern as Nrf2-linked induction. They did not measure Nrf2 protein or its movement into the nucleus.
records.limitation: This is three days of that homogenate in healthy adults and nasal enzyme RNA, not brain Nrf2, an ordinary broccoli serving, or the four-week sprout-extract capsules that did not raise lung target-gene expression in COPD.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Defined broccoli-sprout homogenate raised nasal phase-II gene RNA relative to the control preparation.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Nasal target-gene response, not brain/ADHD effect, universal serving response or direct measurement of Nrf2 activation in every tissue.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary abstract; precise preparation retained from prior full source assessment.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: The COPD capsule trial did not increase the assessed Nrf2 target-gene endpoints.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Different tissue, disease and formulation; prevents a uniform exposure-response claim.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Existing assessed primary null; targeted recheck recorded separately.

records.exposure_qualification: This is three days of that homogenate in healthy adults and nasal enzyme RNA, not brain Nrf2, an ordinary broccoli serving, or the four-week sprout-extract capsules that did not raise lung target-gene expression in COPD.

records.pm_mission: Limit glycaemic volatility so post-prandial glucose swings do not create unnecessary metabolic and neuroendocrine stress.
records.biological_role: In adults with type 2 diabetes, the tested less-processed whole-grain package reduced daily glucose standard deviation and mean amplitude of glycaemic excursions (MAGE) versus a nutrient-matched finely processed package over two weeks.
records.limitation: A food package, not an isolated grain or fibre effect; unmasked foods, short duration. Concealed randomisation, blinded CGM, initial masked analysis and intention-to-treat models support appraisal.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Less-processed whole-grain package reduced CGM excursions and variability relative to finely milled nutrient-matched grains.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: 31 enrolled, 28 completed; two weeks; type 2 diabetes; combined oats/rice/bread package. Not an isolated fibre effect or brain outcome.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.

records.exposure_qualification: The less-milled whole-grain package is the exposure; not a biochemical dietary requirement or equivalent to adding isolated fibre.

mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Early time restriction added to calorie restriction did not improve average glucose or insulin-sensitivity measures over calorie restriction alone.

mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.

records.exposure_qualification: Candidate early/front-loaded eating strategy in dysglycaemia; no universally optimal window or established brain/ADHD benefit. Longer trial with a different protocol was null.
